_note: Wires for the conflict feed: invasions and offensives, strikes, attacks on civilians, the arms industry and the money behind it, bases and corridors, officials and command, law and accountability, nuclear and strategic forces, and humanitarian consequence. Each wire carries a 'standing': official (UN bodies, courts, ministries, alliances), research (SIPRI, ACLED, HRW, Amnesty, Bellingcat, Airwars), trade (defence trade press), or press. Locale coverage is expanded by the same market-and-slice method as the other feeds. Locale coverage is expanded: several country editions per language, and each query split into slices so no single search hits Google News's ~100-result cap.
